signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Set and manage the integration roadmap for HCM, ATS, LMS and related workforce technology partners.
Lead integration programs with strategic partners, coordinating business and technical stakeholders from planning through launch.
Work closely with Product and Engineering to define integration requirements, data exchange modalities and patterns, data mapping, security needs, and implementation plans.
Experience managing third party integration vendors (out of house engineering teams and business relationships).
Establish repeatable processes for partner onboarding, technical validation, testing, certification, release management, and ongoing maintenance.
